newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK foreign reserves US$63.4 bln at end March -govt.
newsitem.headline: HK foreign reserves US$63.4 bln at end March -govt.

text.p: Hong Kong's foreign reserves held in the Exchange Fund, excluding unsettled forward transactions, stood at US$63.4 billion at the end of March, the government said on Thursday.
The amount was slightly lower than the US$63.8 billion at the end of February, the government said in a statement.
The decrease in March represented seasonal drawdowns in fiscal reserves and placements from the Exchange Fund by the government and other institutions, it said.
